name: What factors determine the cost of interior trim repair?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of interior trim repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of interior trim repair depends on the total linear footage, the type of wood or MDF material, accessibility, and whether finishing is included. Straightforward tasks like filling nail holes, recaulking, and touching up baseboards cost considerably less than reconstructing custom crown molding or carved door casings. Homeowners should also factor in whether adjoining drywall or interior paint needs blending. Working with a contractor who handles both carpentry and finish painting helps control expenses by avoiding the need to hire separate trades to prep, patch, prime, and coat the repaired woodwork.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on the linear footage, material type, profile complexity, and whether adjacent drywall patching and finish painting are bundled into the project scope.
